headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 17, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory behind Jesús Luzardo's strong performance. The Kansas City Royals fell short against the Washington Nationals, while the Toronto Blue Jays took down the Boston Red Sox 6-1. The New York Yankees routed the Chicago White Sox 12-2, and the Yankees' José Caballero led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Gleyber Torres (left oblique strain) and Will Wilson (left thumb fracture) of the Detroit Tigers and Seattle Mariners, respectively. Randy Arozarena (left hamstring strain) and Angel Martínez (left foot non-displaced fracture) of the Seattle Mariners and Cleveland Guardians have also been placed on the injured list. Brad Keller (right forearm tendinitis) of the Philadelphia Phillies, Daniel Palencia (right elbow inflammation) of the Chicago Cubs, Corey Seager (concussion) of the Texas Rangers, and Grayson Rodriguez (low back inflammation) of the Los Angeles Angels have been placed on the injured list as well.

Several trades have taken place, including the Kansas City Royals acquiring Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for RHP Denis Samudio and cash. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash, and the Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for Future Considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Cruise Past Marlins 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory. Jesús Luzardo led the Phillies to the win, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 4-6 decision to the Washington Nationals, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Nationals' offense. Curtis Mead led the way for the Nationals with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Cease earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 0 ER, 4 BB, 4 H. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, 3 RBI, and 3 AB.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout White Sox 12-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 12-2 victory. José Caballero led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Gleyber Torres Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers second baseman Gleyber Torres has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain, effective retroactive to June 16, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Connor Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their roster, trading RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold.
